comment: PATHLIGHT guidance strings — the hud.nav.* namespace. Guidance is visual and continuous; these strings label it, they never do the guidance work. Waypoint display names in Basic Training are neutral (P1..P6), never fictional callsigns. VO lines here are <= 8 words, no key names, no bearings the HUD already shows.
hud.nav.offer.reposition: Hold {bind:skip_step} to reposition onto the route.
